propositions: An authenticated file_impact_scope: none assertion must be validated at plan-review time to prevent false declarations from silencing drift protection
The no-file-impact criterion applies only when persisted scope is exactly 'none'; paths, undeclared, missing, None, and unknown values must not trigger an LLM call

The criterion decision rules require every sub-answer field (assertion_plausible, reason_grounded, repo_file_change_named) to drive the judgment outcome and return either PASS, advisory contradiction, or non-blocking insufficient coaching

The declared no_file_impact_reason must round-trip through deterministic structured JSON context into the Pass-1 LLM request, preserving quotes, newlines, and Unicode exactly, with missing reasons serialized as an explicit empty string
Chunks containing both G5 and no-file-impact criteria must receive both context blocks in stable order via compositional extra_parts rather than bespoke orchestration
